text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the Mega Fan Fest rolls around,<n>Symboli Rudolf
leads the event with<n>her usual self-confidence, but
her<n>performance is marred by<n>uncharacteristic
oversights.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, she doesn't let that faze her as<n>she takes her
place in the exhibition<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Rudolf steps up to the<n>starting line, the
crowd gets ready for<n>a race worthy of the
Emperor—but her<n>showing falls far short of their
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For a long time after, the stands are<n>filled with
muttering about her<n>lackluster performance.
